services.name: Outdoor Exhibit
services.desc: "The Walls" is a free outdoor art exhibit with huge 8'x8' murals painted by local artists. "The Walls" are located on the lawn of the Harrington School. This installation's theme for the artists is "God, family, country." Come visit and be sure to tag your social media posts with #harringtonwalls to support these wonderful artists. Are you looking to feature your work on the wall? We need you. Please click the apply button below and fill out the form. We are extremely proud to present the artists of the 7th installment of "The Walls." Each artist spent anywhere from 1-3 weeks working on these masterpieces. They were given materials and a theme, the rest was up to their intepretation of what
